findings.text: the 2/12 numerator is two reattachments to pre-existing accepted identities using per_toroidal_mode and flux_surface_averaged, while the repaired defect was the coordinate-indexed derivative_with_respect_to operator lookup; without a base-versus-repaired comparison or a recovered coordinate-indexed case, this measures pipeline recovery after the repair but not how much recovery the classifier caused.

the recorded done_when requires the sample to be released with sn retry --failed, but this receipt proves the command released zero of twelve and the resumed run composed them directly under coordinator advice; that is a justified gate change, not satisfaction of the unchanged recorded gate, so promotion must preserve the deviation rather than call the original measure passed.

the only full transcript is referenced under crew/runs and no test references this evidence file or its cumulative anchor, so a later edit to the 109-row census, 47-source denominator, or 2/12 outcome can still pass every recorded audit-doc and diff-check gate.
